notes.content:

 - Can now kill skinwalkers with a hatchet

 - Started adding variety of road environments, currently added small residential area

More fixes and features coming next!

notes.title: New build is live!
notes.content:
- Fixed car attachment glitch 
- Objects no longer get stuck to controllers 
- Grip button now resets position when inside car 
- Can now throw objects 
- Skinwalkers no longer clip through 
- Road colliders are now wider 
- Reduced the size of logs 
- Increased the speed of skinwalkers 
- Smoothen out steering 
- Increased heartbeat warning distance 
Will add ability to grab the wheel and add more interaction with the car a bit later, 
More fixes and overall content coming soon!
